_meta.description: Calibration anchors for set_population: credible published estimates of Pokemon TCG print runs, graded-population totals, or packs sold. Used to calibrate and sanity-check the relative-population model (graded_pop / popularity). See docs/prior_art.md for methodology and citations.

credibility_legend.official: Published by The Pokemon Company / WotC, or directly derived from an official figure.
credibility_legend.well-sourced-estimate: Hobbyist/analyst estimate built on a documented chain of reasoning and at least one verifiable input (pop report, official checkpoint, pull rate).
credibility_legend.hobbyist-guess: Round number with no documented derivation; treat as a weak prior only.

_meta.warning: A wrong anchor poisons calibration worse than a missing one. Several values below are explicitly flagged hobbyist-guess. Do NOT hard-anchor on those; use them only for order-of-magnitude sanity checks. The graded_pop_total anchors are the most reliable (directly countable from pop reports) but are NOT print runs -- grading rate is exactly the popularity bias the project is trying to correct for, so they are an endogenous cross-check, not a ground-truth divisor.
_meta.set_id_convention: Matches dim_sets in the main repo. base1=Base, base2=Jungle, base3=Fossil, base4=Base Set 2, base5=Team Rocket, gym1=Gym Heroes, gym2=Gym Challenge, neo1=Neo Genesis, neo2=Neo Discovery, neo3=Neo Revelation, neo4=Neo Destiny, ex7=Team Rocket Returns.

anchors.notes: Official 'Pokemon in Figures' cumulative total: 75 billion cards printed worldwide since 1996, as of end of FY2024-25 (Mar 2025). This is the single hardest anchor available -- it caps the sum of all per-set estimates. ~44.6B (60%) printed since FY2020-21, confirming production is heavily back-loaded to the modern era.

Official cumulative checkpoint: 23.6B through Mar 2017. Useful as an upper bound for the SUM of all WOTC + early-modern sets. Other official checkpoints: ~43.2B (Mar 2022), 52.9B (Mar 2023), 64.9B (Mar 2024). Annual: 9.7B (FY22), 11.9B (FY23, record), 10.2B (FY24).

12 billion CUMULATIVE cards printed end of 2001 (an official-ish checkpoint cited in the Elite Fourum thread), NOT Neo Revelation alone. Listed under neo3 because Neo Revelation (Sep 2001) is the set straddling that checkpoint. Per-set average implied by the thread: ~1.2B/set across the WOTC era. Do not read 12B as a single-set figure.

1st Edition Base is the smallest WOTC run -- printed in a very short window (WotC FAQ cited as '3 days') before Pokemania peaked. Elite Fourum derives ~10% of Base Set total as 1st Ed. Wide band: the popular '100,000 1st-Edition Charizards printed' figure (ogcards.com) has no documented source. The number here is total cards in the SET, not just Charizard. Treat as order-of-magnitude only.

1st Edition Base Charizard (#4) graded population across all companies = 6,115 (PSA 4,484 incl. 125 PSA-10; BGS thick 405 + thin 724; CGC 502). This is ONE card, not the whole set. Inflated by crack-and-resubmit. The article estimates <10,000 surviving copies of the Charizard. Use as a per-chase-card pop anchor, exactly the kind of signal the project's chase_graded_pop.json will collect.

Shadowless Base Charizard (#4) graded pop = 13,885 (PSA 10,635 incl. 58 PSA-10; CGC 1,571; BGS 1,679). Article estimates ~15,000+ surviving. One card. Note shadowless is rarer than Unlimited but more common than 1st Ed -- and shadowless graded pop > 1st-Ed graded pop, consistent with that ordering. Good ratio anchor: shadowless ~2.3x 1st-Ed Charizard graded pop.

Elite Fourum estimates ~3 billion cards for the entire Base Set (all variants, all languages), Unlimited being the overwhelming majority (print runs 2-7). Cross-checked against '2 million starter decks sold (1999)' as a lower-bound validation. Total-cards figure; divide by ~11 cards/pack and 15 holos for per-holo counts. Order-of-magnitude only.

~1.75 billion total cards (all languages), derived from official cumulative checkpoints divided across sets. WIP estimate flagged by the author as containing 'wild ass guesses'. Total cards, not packs.
~1.75 billion total cards, same checkpoint-division method as Jungle. WIP / low confidence.

~600 million total cards; lower than Base/Jungle/Fossil because it released into a cooling-demand period. Useful as a relative-ranking data point (Base Set 2 < the original three). WIP / low confidence.
~1.1 billion total cards; high sustained interest kept the print run large. WIP / low confidence.
~850 million total cards (estimate also applied to Gym Challenge / gym2). Sustained-interest tier. WIP / low confidence.

~700 million total cards each for Neo Genesis/Discovery/Revelation, derived from the '12B cumulative end-2001 = ~1.2B/set avg' checkpoint. WIP / low confidence. Same per-set figure can be applied to neo2, neo3, neo4 absent better data.

~80 million total cards -> ~247,000 booster boxes (80M x 1/9 x 1/36) -> ~41,000 of each Gold Star Pokemon. Demonstrates the pull-rate x packs method end-to-end. EX era is much smaller per-set than WOTC. ~30% of EX-set print runs were precon theme decks (must subtract for booster-only math). WIP / low confidence.

anchors.set_name: Modern set average (EX/BW era ~200M; XY era ~150M cards/set)
anchors.notes: Per-set averages cited: ~200M cards/set (EX/BW era), ~150M cards/set (XY era). NOT specific to one set_id -- use as a modern-era baseline. NOTE these PRE-DATE the post-2020 explosion: Scarlet&Violet-era sets are far larger (FY2023 alone was 11.9B cards across the year's sets). Treat as a floor for modern, not current.
13.0B cumulative end-Mar 2005 (Base through EX Deoxys/Team Rocket Returns). TPCi Pokemon-in-Figures checkpoint.
30.4B cumulative end-Mar 2020 (end of SM era, pre-SWSH explosion). TPCi Pokemon-in-Figures.
34.1B cumulative end-Mar 2021. FY2020-21 annual = 3.7B.
43.2B cumulative end-Mar 2022. FY2021-22 annual = 9.1B (SWSH peak).
85B cumulative end-Mar 2026 (latest TPCi milestone, supersedes 75B Mar-2025 anchor).
~200M/set DP-era average (Ravaver 2026, Elite Fourum Era 2).
~200M/set HGSS-era average. Often cited as lowest-print modern era.
~200M/set BW-era average. Demand revival post-HGSS slump.
~150M/set XY-era average. xy12 Evolutions is the major upward outlier.
~485M/set SM-era mid, derived from (30.4B Mar-2020 - 23.6B Mar-2017) / ~16 sets.
~1.5B/set SWSH-era mid, derived from FY2020-21+22+23 ÷ ~18 SWSH sets.
~2.5B/set SV-era mid, derived from FY2022-23+23-24+24-25 totals.
~30-50% of standard SM expansion. Multi-wave reprint.
~30-50% of mainline SWSH. Sold out pre-release.
~40-60% of standard SWSH. Peak pandemic demand window.
25th-anniversary set. 4-card packs (not 10), so card-count math differs.
~30-50% of standard expansion. ETB/Tin only.
Two print waves. Reprinted 2025; EOL Spring 2026.
~2.5-year sustained reprints. Plausibly 1.5-3x mainline SV.
20th-anniv Base Set reprint. Largest XY-era set by print run.
Peak pandemic demand (FY2021-22 = 9.1B). Likely highest-print SWSH mainline; first-print labels #1-#6.
